address: Rue du Lejat - lieu-dit La Berlanderie, Croutelle, 86240, France
bio: The focus here is on good old-fashioned fare, in all its generosity and simplicity. Traditional French favourites, enlivened by the occasional more contemporary note, are served in a stylish space or, even better, in the extension overlooking the grounds, which are planted with century-old oak trees. A warm welcome and friendly service....
